name: Generalizable Implicit Reconstruction with SRDF
aliases: Volume Rendering of Signed Ray Distance Functions for Generalizable Multi-View Reconstruction
definition: A generalizable implicit reconstruction method that uses Signed Ray Distance Function (SRDF) to reconstruct scenes with fine details and little noise by combining projection features aggregated from multi-view features and volume features interpolated from a coarse global feature volume.
summary: VolRecon predicts a Signed Ray Distance Function to reconstruct scenes from multi-view images, distinguishing itself by constraining distance to the viewing ray for robust surface localization.
